subject: HDFS.init() Hanging in R Console and RGui

messages.author: 052ad17a7f0926f9
messages.subject: HDFS.init() Hanging in R Console and RGui
parts:
Hi there,

I am new to the world of Hadoop and trying to integrate RHadoop repos with a Hadoop lab built of HDP 1.3 for Windows. I can successfully run:

library(rmr2)

and 

library(rhdfs)

from the R console and GUI.

But, when I run hdfs.init(), the process just hangs. We are currently building this lab as a proof of concept to evaluate how our organization might leverage Hadoop. Our CTO and analytics folks would like to see how R plays with Hadoop as well. 

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: 1eafd5d24fb29c12
messages.subject: Re: HDFS.init() Hanging in R Console and RGui
parts:
I haven't seen hdfs.init "hang" before.  Are you sure you have rJava installed and working properly?  Did you set the HADOOP_CMD environment variable?  You can always set through the source code of the function to see what might be causing a problem

https://github.com/RevolutionAnalytics/rhdfs/blob/master/pkg/R/hdfs.r
